name: com.quasslabs/api
title: QuassLabs API
description: 29 deterministic dev and delivery tools: linting, metrics, diagrams, model advice, AI-text checks.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.auth: Bearer qlk_* API key required for tools/call. initialize, tools/list and ping are unauthenticated so the catalog is discoverable without credentials. OAuth 2.1 deferred (only the Anthropic Connectors Directory requires it).
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.namespaceVerification: com.quasslabs/* is granted by DNS verification of the apex quasslabs.com, not api.quasslabs.com - the registry derives the namespace from the reverse-DNS of the verified domain.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.toolCount: 29 live. Two further tools (supply_chain_scan, compress) are built but gated on a container image build, so tools/list correctly omits them.
